name: Poogal–Khajuwala National Highway
significance: NH 911A is a branch of NH 911. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Poogal to Khajuwala, and it meets NH 911 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 911 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Sri Ganganagar to Bap
